chapters.name: The Red Room
chapters.about: Diwali week. Deep reds, black lacquer, candle light and the gold that reads best against them.

chapters.name: The Index
chapters.about: The catalogue laid bare: cream plaster, straight light, one piece per frame. The wedding-season index.

chapters.name: Sage
chapters.about: Celadon dishes, sage linen, pea pods and brushed steel. The quiet-luxury fortnight.

chapters.name: The Gift
chapters.about: Christmas and New Year gifting. The blush Naira box, ribbon, pearls and satin.

chapters.name: Lilac
chapters.about: New Year light: lilac paper, lavender, butterflies and pastel tennis rows.

chapters.name: Apricot
chapters.about: Raw apricot silk, halved fruit, croissants and brushed gold. The sunny close of the season.
